label: Senja connection
description: Needed to copy testimonials into Swell and send review invites. Requires a Senja Starter plan or higher. Widgets work without it.

fields.label: API key
fields.description: In Senja, open Automate and copy your API key.

fields.label: Webhook secret
fields.description: Any random string. Enter the same value as the secret when you add the Swell webhook in Senja's Automate tab.
